items.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash: Next-Gen Agentic & Coding Model (200+ TPS, 70% Cheaper)
items.snippet: MiniMax officially launched M3.1 Flash (formerly anonymous Space Bunny with 200T+ tokens on OpenRouter). 428B total / 23B active MoE with 1M context, 73.7% DeepSWE v1.1, 200+ TPS peak speed, zsh.15/zsh.60 per 1M tokens.
